title: Analysis by Merrick's colleagues points to a Tic Tac-shaped craft
summary: Merrick von Renenamp tells of Analysis by Merrick's colleagues points to a Tic Tac-shaped craft, about 2004 at Off Southern California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: but I have fairly high confidence that that was a tick tap shake craft

related.note: An analysis of the same FLIR1 footage that concludes it shows a Tic Tac-shaped craft, against telling 6's distant aircraft.

plain: In 2004, off Southern California, a Navy jet's infrared camera filmed an unknown object, and the clip is known as the FLIR1 video. In a debate on Jesse Michels's podcast with a skeptic named Mick West, Merrick von Renenamp says analysis by colleagues, including an unnamed California scientist, gives him fairly high confidence the object was a Tic Tac shaped craft, a white oval like the mint. If true, it would mean the video shows a real unknown craft, not a distant plane or balloon.
